Now I need to design the Dockerfile carefully. Key challenges:
- `trtc-asr` is a git source — the gateway image needs git at build time
- Each service image must contain ONLY its own code
- uv sync from the lockfile
- Distinct non-root UIDs per service
- Code owned by root, not writable by service user

I'll use a multi-stage approach: a builder stage that installs all dependencies, then per-service runtime stages that copy only the needed code + the installed venv.

input.content:
# DCTA service images — T-04 runtime isolation
#
# One Dockerfile with build args to produce three distinct service images:
#   gateway   (UID 10001) — gateway/ ledger/ shared/
#   agent     (UID 10002) — agent/ shared/ prompts/
#   validator (UID 10003) — validator/ shared/ prompts/
#
# Agent and validator images contain NO gateway/ or ledger/ source.
# Each runs as a distinct non-root user; application code is owned by root.
#
# Build:
#   docker build --build-arg SERVICE=gateway  -t dcta-gateway  -f infra/Dockerfile .
#   docker build --build-arg SERVICE=agent    -t dcta-agent    -f infra/Dockerfile .
#   docker build --build-arg SERVICE=validator -t dcta-validator -f infra/Dockerfile .

ARG SERVICE=gateway

# ── Builder stage: install all dependencies from the lockfile ──────────
FROM python:3.12-slim AS builder

# git is required because trtc-asr is a git source in uv.lock
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install uv (matching the project's version manager)
COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.9.15 /uv /uvx /bin/

WORKDIR /build

# Copy only the files needed for dependency resolution
COPY pyproject.toml uv.lock ./

# Sync dependencies from the lockfile (no dev deps, no project install)
RUN uv sync --frozen --no-dev --no-install-project

# ── Runtime stage ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FROM python:3.12-slim AS runtime

ARG SERVICE
ENV SERVICE=${SERVICE}
ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
ENV PATH="/app/.venv/bin:$PATH"

# Map SERVICE to UID and the code directories to copy
# gateway  → UID 10001, copies gateway/ ledger/ shared/
# agent    → UID 10002, copies agent/ shared/ prompts/
# validator→ UID 10003, copies validator/ shared/ prompts/
RUN <<EOF
set -e
case "${SERVICE}" in
  gateway)
    UID_VAL=10001
    ;;
  agent)
    UID_VAL=10002
    ;;
  validator)
    UID_VAL=10003
    ;;
  *)
    echo "Unknown SERVICE: ${SERVICE}" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
groupadd -g "${UID_VAL}" dcta
useradd -u "${UID_VAL}" -g dcta -d /app -s /sbin/nologin dcta
EOF

WORKDIR /app

# Copy the virtual environment from the builder
COPY --from=builder /build/.venv /app/.venv

# Copy ONLY the code each service needs (owned by root, not writable by dcta)
COPY --chown=root:root --chmod=0555 shared/ /app/shared/

RUN <<EOF
set -e
case "${SERVICE}" in
  gateway)
    mkdir -p /app/gateway /app/ledger /data/audio
    cp -a /mnt/src/gateway/. /app/gateway/
    cp -a /mnt/src/ledger/. /app/ledger/
    chown -R root:root /app/gateway /app/ledger
    chmod -R 0555 /app/gateway /app/ledger
    chown -R dcta:dcta /data
    ;;
  agent)
    mkdir -p /app/agent /app/prompts
    cp -a /mnt/src/agent/. /app/agent/
    cp -a /mnt/src/prompts/. /app/prompts/
    chown -R root:root /app/agent /app/prompts
    chmod -R 0555 /app/agent /app/prompts
    ;;
  validator)
    mkdir -p /app/validator /app/prompts
    cp -a /mnt/src/validator/. /app/validator/
    cp -a /mnt/src/prompts/. /app/prompts/
    chown -R root:root /app/validator /app/prompts
    chmod -R 0555 /app/validator /app/prompts
    ;;
esac
EOF

# Create __init__.py if missing (ensures packages are importable)
RUN touch /app/shared/__init__.py

USER dcta

# Entrypoint is set in compose.yaml per-service
CMD ["python", "-c", "import sys; print(f'{\"${SERVICE}\"} ready'); sys.exit(0)"]

content.text:
Now let me create the compose.yaml. Key decisions:
- Two networks: `agent_net` (gateway + agent), `validator_net` (gateway + validator)
- Agent cannot reach validator and vice versa
- Both need outbound internet for LLM APIs — networks are NOT marked `internal`
- Gateway is on both networks
- Agent/validator: read_only, tmpfs /tmp, cap_drop ALL, no-new-privileges, no published ports, no volumes
- Gateway: publishes 8002 to 127.0.0.1, has /data volume, same hardening except needs /data
- Healthchecks on /health
- Gateway runs ledger init/seed on start, then uvicorn

input.content:
# DCTA Compose — T-04 runtime isolation
#
# Run from repo root:
#   docker compose -f infra/compose.yaml --project-directory . up -d
# or:
#   make compose-up
#
# Networks:
#   agent_net     — gateway + agent (agent can reach gateway, NOT validator)
#   validator_net — gateway + validator (validator can reach gateway, NOT agent)
#
# Neither network is marked `internal` so both have outbound internet for LLM APIs.
# Egress choice documented in docs/evidence/T-04-isolation.txt.

name: dcta

services:
  # ── Gateway ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  gateway:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: infra/Dockerfile
      target: gateway
    image: dcta-gateway:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8002:8002"
    volumes:
      - gateway_data:/data
    environment:
      - DCTA_DB_PATH=/data/dcta.db
      - GATEWAY_DELEGATION_SECRET=${GATEWAY_DELEGATION_SECRET:-}
      - SDKAppID=${SDKAppID:-}
      - SDKSecretKey=${SDKSecretKey:-}
      - TRTC_ASR_HOST=${TRTC_ASR_HOST:-asr-intl.cloud-rtc.com}
      - LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY=${LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY:-}
      - LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY=${LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY:-}
      - LANGFUSE_BASE_URL=${LANGFUSE_BASE_URL:-}
      - WEBAUTHN_RP_ID=${WEBAUTHN_RP_ID:-localhost}
      - WEBAUTHN_RP_ORIGIN=${WEBAUTHN_RP_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:5173}
      - NONCE_TTL_SECONDS=${NONCE_TTL_SECONDS:-120}
      - MANDATE_PER_LEG=${MANDATE_PER_LEG:-1000.00}
      - MANDATE_DAILY=${MANDATE_DAILY:-3000.00}
      - RISK_THRESHOLD=${RISK_THRESHOLD:-500.00}
      - COOLING_HOURS=${COOLING_HOURS:-12}
      - DCTA_TIMEZONE=${DCTA_TIMEZONE:-Asia/Singapore}
    networks:
      - agent_net
      - validator_net
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    security_opt: [no-new-privileges:true]
    # Gateway needs a writable /data volume, so read_only is not set here.
    # The volume is the only writable path; the root filesystem is still
    # not writable by the service user.
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python", "-c", "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8002/health')"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    entrypoint: ["sh", "-c"]
    command:
      - |
        python -c "
        from ledger.schema import connect, init_db
        from ledger.seed import seed_db
        conn = connect('/data/dcta.db')
        init_db(conn)
        seed_db(conn)
        conn.close()
        print('ledger initialized and seeded')
        " && exec uvicorn gateway.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8002
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ── Agent ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  agent:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: infra/Dockerfile
      target: agent
    image: dcta-agent:latest
    # NOT published to host
    environment:
      - EXTRACT_PROVIDER=${EXTRACT_PROVIDER:-tokenhub}
      - EXTRACT_MODEL=${EXTRACT_MODEL:-hy3}
      - EXTRACT_MAX_TOKENS=${EXTRACT_MAX_TOKENS:-2048}
      - tokenhub_key=${tokenhub_key:-}
      - deepseek_key=${deepseek_key:-}
      - LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY=${LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY:-}
      - LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY=${LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY:-}
      - LANGFUSE_BASE_URL=${LANGFUSE_BASE_URL:-}
      - GATEWAY_BASE_URL=http://gateway:8002
    networks:
      - agent_net
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    security_opt: [no-new-privileges:true]
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:size=64m
    # No volumes, no bind mounts, no Docker socket
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python", "-c", "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8001/health')"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    command: ["uvicorn", "agent.app:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8001"]
    depends_on:
      gateway:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ── Validator ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  validator:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: infra/Dockerfile
      target: validator
    image: dcta-validator:latest
    # NOT published to host
    environment:
      - VALIDATE_PROVIDER=${VALIDATE_PROVIDER:-deepseek}
      - VALIDATE_MODEL=${VALIDATE_MODEL:-deepseek-flash}
      - VALIDATE_MAX_TOKENS=${VALIDATE_MAX_TOKENS:-2048}
      - tokenhub_key=${tokenhub_key:-}
      - deepseek_key=${deepseek_key:-}
      - LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY=${LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY:-}
      - LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY=${LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY:-}
      - LANGFUSE_BASE_URL=${LANGFUSE_BASE_URL:-}
    networks:
      - validator_net
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    security_opt: [no-new-privileges:true]
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:size=64m
    # No volumes, no bind mounts, no Docker socket
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python", "-c", "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8003/health')"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    command: ["uvicorn", "validator.app:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8003"]
    depends_on:
      gateway:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped

networks:
  agent_net:
    driver: bridge

"""T-04 isolation probe — stdlib only, run inside agent/validator containers.

Usage (inside a container):

    python /probes/isolation_probe.py

Each check prints a line:

    PASS  <check name>  <reason>
    FAIL  <check name>  <reason>

Expected-to-be-denied checks should print PASS when the access is denied.
Expected-to-succeed checks should print PASS when the access succeeds.

The GATEWAY_HOST environment variable (default: gateway) is used for
HTTP probes.  The SERVICE environment variable identifies which service
the probe is running in (agent or validator).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import socket
import sys
import traceback
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from urllib.error import URLError, HTTPError

GATEWAY_HOST = os.environ.get("GATEWAY_HOST", "gateway")
GATEWAY_PORT = 8002
SERVICE = os.environ.get("SERVICE", "unknown")

# Gateway secret variable NAMES to check for (never print values).
GATEWAY_SECRET_NAMES = [
    "SDKSecretKey",
    "GATEWAY_DELEGATION_SECRET",
    "SDKAppID",
    "WEBAUTHN_RP_ID",
    "WEBAUTHN_RP_ORIGIN",
    "DCTA_DB_PATH",
    "MANDATE_PER_LEG",
    "MANDATE_DAILY",
    "RISK_THRESHOLD",
    "COOLING_HOURS",
    "NONCE_TTL_SECONDS",
    "DCTA_TIMEZONE",
]

# Expected UIDs per service
EXPECTED_UIDS = {
    "agent": 10002,
    "validator": 10003,
    "gateway": 10001,
}

# App code directories per service
APP_CODE_DIRS = {
    "agent": ["/app/agent", "/app/shared", "/app/prompts"],
    "validator": ["/app/validator", "/app/shared", "/app/prompts"],
    "gateway": ["/app/gateway", "/app/ledger", "/app/shared"],
}

results: list[tuple[str, str, str, str]] = []  # (status, check, expected, observed)


def record(status: str, check: str, expected: str, observed: str) -> None:
    results.append((status, check, expected, observed))
    print(f"{status:4s}  {check}  expected={expected}  observed={observed}")


def expect_denied(label: str, fn):
    """Run fn expecting it to raise an exception (denied)."""
    try:
        fn()
        record("FAIL", label, "denied", "succeeded (no exception)")
    except Exception as exc:
        record("PASS", label, "denied", f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")


def expect_succeed(label: str, fn, *args, **kwargs):
    """Run fn expecting it to succeed."""
    try:
        result = fn(*args, **kwargs)
        record("PASS", label, "success", str(result)[:200])
    except Exception as exc:
        record("FAIL", label, "success", f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")


# ── Check 1: Ledger file access ──────────────────────────────────────

def check_ledger_file():
    """Try to open /data/dcta.db for read and write."""
    def try_read():
        with open("/data/dcta.db", "r") as f:
            f.read(1)
    expect_denied("open /data/dcta.db for read", try_read)

    def try_write():
        with open("/data/dcta.db", "a") as f:
            f.write("")
    expect_denied("open /data/dcta.db for write", try_write)

    # Search for any .db file on the filesystem
    def find_db_files():
        found = []
        for root_dir in ["/app", "/data", "/tmp"]:
            if not os.path.exists(root_dir):
                continue
            try:
                for entry in Path(root_dir).rglob("*.db*"):
                    found.append(str(entry))
            except (PermissionError, OSError):
                continue
        if found:
            raise RuntimeError(f"found db files: {found}")
        return "no db files found"
    expect_succeed("no *.db files in container", find_db_files)


# ── Check 2: Import gateway/ledger ────────────────────────────────────

def check_imports():
    """Try to import gateway and ledger — should be ModuleNotFoundError."""
    def try_import_gateway():
        import gateway  # noqa: F401
    expect_denied("import gateway", try_import_gateway)

    def try_import_ledger():
        import ledger  # noqa: F401
    expect_denied("import ledger", try_import_ledger)

    def try_import_gateway_app():
        from gateway import app  # noqa: F401
    expect_denied("import gateway.app", try_import_gateway_app)

    def try_import_ledger_schema():
        from ledger import schema  # noqa: F401
    expect_denied("import ledger.schema", try_import_ledger_schema)


# ── Check 3: Write to application code directory and / ────────────────

def check_write_protection():
    """Write to app code dir and / — should be permission denied or read-only."""
    app_dirs = APP_CODE_DIRS.get(SERVICE, ["/app"])

    for code_dir in app_dirs:
        test_file = os.path.join(code_dir, ".isolation_probe_write_test")
        def try_write_code_dir(d=test_file):
            with open(d, "w") as f:
                f.write("test")
        expect_denied(f"write to {code_dir}", try_write_code_dir)

    def try_write_root():
        with open("/.isolation_probe_write_test", "w") as f:
            f.write("test")
    expect_denied("write to /", try_write_root)


# ── Check 4: Docker socket absent ─────────────────────────────────────

def check_docker_socket():
    """/var/run/docker.sock must not exist."""
    sock_path = "/var/run/docker.sock"
    if os.path.exists(sock_path):
        record("FAIL", "docker.sock absent", "absent", "present at /var/run/docker.sock")
    else:
        record("PASS", "docker.sock absent", "absent", "not found")


# ── Check 5: No host workspace mount ──────────────────────────────────

def check_no_host_mount():
    """No pyproject.toml/.git outside /app, no /workspace mount."""
    # Check for pyproject.toml at / (would indicate host mount)
    if os.path.exists("/pyproject.toml"):
        record("FAIL", "no host pyproject.toml", "absent", "found at /pyproject.toml")
    else:
        record("PASS", "no host pyproject.toml", "absent", "not at /pyproject.toml")

    # Check for .git at / (would indicate host mount)
    if os.path.exists("/.git"):
        record("FAIL", "no host .git", "absent", "found at /.git")
    else:
        record("PASS", "no host .git", "absent", "not at /.git")

    # Check no /workspace directory
    if os.path.exists("/workspace"):
        record("FAIL", "no /workspace mount", "absent", "found at /workspace")
    else:
        record("PASS", "no /workspace mount", "absent", "not at /workspace")

    # Check the app's pyproject.toml doesn't exist (we don't copy it)
    if os.path.exists("/app/pyproject.toml"):
        record("FAIL", "no pyproject.toml in image", "absent", "found at /app/pyproject.toml")
    else:
        record("PASS", "no pyproject.toml in image", "absent", "not at /app/pyproject.toml")


# ── Check 6: No gateway secrets in environment ────────────────────────

def check_no_gateway_secrets():
    """Environment must not contain gateway-only secret variable names."""
    found_secrets = []
    for name in GATEWAY_SECRET_NAMES:
        if name in os.environ:
            found_secrets.append(name)

    if found_secrets:
        record(
            "FAIL",
            "no gateway secrets in env",
            f"none of {GATEWAY_SECRET_NAMES}",
            f"FOUND variable NAMES (values redacted): {found_secrets}",
        )
    else:
        record(
            "PASS",
            "no gateway secrets in env",
            f"none of {GATEWAY_SECRET_NAMES}",
            "none found",
        )


# ── Check 7: HTTP probes to gateway ───────────────────────────────────

def _http_request(method, path, host=GATEWAY_HOST, port=GATEWAY_PORT, body=None, headers=None):
    """Make an HTTP request.  Returns (status_code, body_text) or raises."""
    url = f"http://{host}:{port}{path}"
    hdrs = headers or {}
    data = body.encode("utf-8") if body else None
    req = Request(url, data=data, method=method, headers=hdrs)
    try:
        resp = urlopen(req, timeout=5)
        return resp.status, resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")[:200]
    except HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, str(e)[:200]
    except URLError as e:
        raise


def check_gateway_http_denied():
    """Unauthenticated/malformed/forged HTTP to gateway internal routes → 401."""

    # No token
    try:
        status, body = _http_request("GET", "/internal/bank/accounts")
        if status == 401:
            record("PASS", "GET /internal/bank/accounts no token", "401", f"{status}")
        else:
            record("FAIL", "GET /internal/bank/accounts no token", "401", f"{status}")
    except Exception as exc:
        record("FAIL", "GET /internal/bank/accounts no token", "401", f"error: {exc}")

    # Malformed token
    try:
        status, body = _http_request(
            "GET", "/internal/bank/accounts",
            headers={"Authorization": "Bearer malformed-token-xyz"},
        )
        if status == 401:
            record("PASS", "GET /internal/bank/accounts malformed token", "401", f"{status}")
        else:
            record("FAIL", "GET /internal/bank/accounts malformed token", "401", f"{status}")
    except Exception as exc:
        record("FAIL", "GET /internal/bank/accounts malformed token", "401", f"error: {exc}")

    # Forged token (signed with wrong secret)
    import base64
    import hashlib
    import hmac
    import json
    import time

    wrong_secret = b"x" * 64
    payload = {
        "user_id": "user-matthew",
        "scopes": ["bank:read"],
        "issued_at": int(time.time()),
        "expires_at": int(time.time()) + 300,
        "token_id": "forged",
    }
    body_bytes = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
    sig = hmac.new(wrong_secret, body_bytes, hashlib.sha256).digest()
    encoded_body = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(body_bytes).decode("ascii")
    encoded_sig = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(sig).decode("ascii")
    forged_token = f"dcta_{encoded_body}.{encoded_sig}"

    try:
        status, body = _http_request(
            "GET", "/internal/bank/accounts",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {forged_token}"},
        )
        if status == 401:
            record("PASS", "GET /internal/bank/accounts forged token", "401", f"{status}")
        else:
            record("FAIL", "GET /internal/bank/accounts forged token", "401", f"{status}")
    except Exception as exc:
        record("FAIL", "GET /internal/bank/accounts forged token", "401", f"error: {exc}")

    # POST /api/conversations/{id}/text — fabricated user turn
    try:
        status, body = _http_request(
            "POST", "/api/conversations/fake-conv-id/text",
            body='{"text":"pay mum 50"}',
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        )
        if status == 401:
            record("PASS", "POST /api/conversations/.../text fabricated turn", "401", f"{status}")
        else:
            record("FAIL", "POST /api/conversations/.../text fabricated turn", "401", f"{status}")
    except Exception as exc:
        record("FAIL", "POST /api/conversations/.../text fabricated turn", "401", f"error: {exc}")

    # /internal/audit/agent-events without token
    try:
        status, body = _http_request(
            "POST", "/internal/audit/agent-events",
            body='{"step":"agent.extract","payload":{}}',
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        )
        if status == 401:
            record("PASS", "POST /internal/audit/agent-events no token", "401", f"{status}")
        else:
            record("FAIL", "POST /internal/audit/agent-events no token", "401", f"{status}")
    except Exception as exc:
        record("FAIL", "POST /internal/audit/agent-events no token", "401", f"error: {exc}")


# ── Check 8: Cross-service connectivity ────────────────────────────────

def check_cross_service():
    """Agent cannot reach validator:8003; validator cannot reach agent:8001."""
    if SERVICE == "agent":
        # Try to connect to validator:8003 — should fail
        try:
            sock = socket.create_connection(("validator", 8003), timeout=3)
            sock.close()
            record("FAIL", "agent→validator:8003", "unreachable", "connected!")
        except (socket.gaierror, ConnectionRefusedError, TimeoutError, OSError) as exc:
            record("PASS", "agent→validator:8003", "unreachable", f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
    elif SERVICE == "validator":
        # Try to connect to agent:8001 — should fail
        try:
            sock = socket.create_connection(("agent", 8001), timeout=3)
            sock.close()
            record("FAIL", "validator→agent:8001", "unreachable", "connected!")
        except (socket.gaierror, ConnectionRefusedError, TimeoutError, OSError) as exc:
            record("PASS", "validator→agent:8001", "unreachable", f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")


# ── Check 9: Gateway /health reachable ────────────────────────────────

def check_gateway_health():
    """Gateway /health should be reachable from both agent and validator."""
    try:
        status, body = _http_request("GET", "/health")
        if status == 200:
            record("PASS", "gateway /health reachable", "200", f"{status}")
        else:
            record("FAIL", "gateway /health reachable", "200", f"{status}")
    except Exception as exc:
        record("FAIL", "gateway /health reachable", "200", f"error: {exc}")


# ── Check 10: Process UID ──────────────────────────────────────────────

def check_uid():
    """Own process user must be the expected non-root UID."""
    uid = os.getuid()
    expected = EXPECTED_UIDS.get(SERVICE)
    if expected is not None and uid == expected:
        record("PASS", "process UID", f"{expected}", f"uid={uid}")
    else:
        record("FAIL", "process UID", f"{expected}", f"uid={uid}")


# ── Check 11: Own /health endpoint ────────────────────────────────────

def check_own_health():
    """Own /health should respond 200."""
    own_port = {"agent": 8001, "validator": 8003, "gateway": 8002}.get(SERVICE)
    if own_port is None:
        record("SKIP", "own /health", "200", f"unknown service: {SERVICE}")
        return
    try:
        status, body = _http_request("GET", "/health", host="127.0.0.1", port=own_port)
        if status == 200:
            record("PASS", "own /health", "200", f"{status}")
        else:
            record("FAIL", "own /health", "200", f"{status}")
    except Exception as exc:
        record("FAIL", "own /health", "200", f"error: {exc}")


# ── Main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def main():
    print(f"\n{'=' * 72}")
    print(f"T-04 Isolation Probe — service={SERVICE} — pid={os.getpid()} uid={os.getuid()}")
    print(f"Gateway host: {GATEWAY_HOST}:{GATEWAY_PORT}")
    print(f"{'=' * 72}\n")

    print("--- Ledger file access ---")
    check_ledger_file()

    print("\n--- Import gateway/ledger ---")
    check_imports()

    print("\n--- Write protection ---")
    check_write_protection()

    print("\n--- Docker socket ---")
    check_docker_socket()

    print("\n--- No host workspace mount ---")
    check_no_host_mount()

    print("\n--- No gateway secrets in env ---")
    check_no_gateway_secrets()

    print("\n--- Gateway HTTP denial (401) ---")
    check_gateway_http_denied()

    print("\n--- Cross-service connectivity ---")
    check_cross_service()

    print("\n--- Gateway /health reachable ---")
    check_gateway_health()

    print("\n--- Process UID ---")
    check_uid()

    print("\n--- Own /health ---")
    check_own_health()

    # Summary
    passes = sum(1 for r in results if r[0] == "PASS")
    fails = sum(1 for r in results if r[0] == "FAIL")
    skips = sum(1 for r in results if r[0] == "SKIP")
    print(f"\n{'=' * 72}")
    print(f"SUMMARY: {passes} PASS, {fails} FAIL, {skips} SKIP (total {len(results)})")
    print(f"{'=' * 72}\n")

    return 1 if fails > 0 else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        sys.exit(main())
    except Exception:
        traceback.print_exc()
        sys.exit(2)

"""Test infra/compose.yaml for T-04 isolation properties.

Asserts that agent and validator services:
- have no volumes or bind mounts
- have no published ports
- have read_only: true
- are not on each other's network
- have cap_drop: [ALL]
- have security_opt: [no-new-privileges:true]

Also asserts .dockerignore contains .env.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

_REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
_COMPOSE_PATH = _REPO_ROOT / "infra" / "compose.yaml"
_DOCKERIGNORE = _REPO_ROOT / ".dockerignore"


def _load_compose():
    """Load compose.yaml.  Use yaml if available; else skip with reason."""
    try:
        import yaml  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
    except ImportError:
        pytest.skip("PyYAML not installed; compose YAML assertions skipped")
    text = _COMPOSE_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    return yaml.safe_load(text)


def _get_service(compose: dict, name: str) -> dict:
    services = compose.get("services", {})
    assert name in services, f"service '{name}' not found in compose"
    return services[name]


class TestComposeIsolation:
    """Verify agent/validator are isolated per T-04 requirements."""

    def test_compose_file_exists(self) -> None:
        assert _COMPOSE_PATH.exists(), "infra/compose.yaml must exist"

    def test_agent_no_volumes(self) -> None:
        compose = _load_compose()
        agent = _get_service(compose, "agent")
        assert "volumes" not in agent, "agent must not have volumes"
        assert "volumes" not in agent or agent.get("volumes") is None

    def test_validator_no_volumes(self) -> None:
        compose = _load_compose()
        validator = _get_service(compose, "validator")
        assert "volumes" not in validator, "validator must not have volumes"

    def test_agent_no_published_ports(self) -> None:
        compose = _load_compose()
        agent = _get_service(compose, "agent")
        assert "ports" not in agent, "agent must not publish ports"

    def test_validator_no_published_ports(self) -> None:
        compose = _load_compose()
        validator = _get_service(compose, "validator")
        assert "ports" not in validator, "validator must not publish ports"

    def test_agent_read_only(self) -> None:
        compose = _load_compose()
        agent = _get_service(compose, "agent")
        assert agent.get("read_only") is True, "agent must have read_only: true"

    def test_validator_read_only(self) -> None:
        compose = _load_compose()
        validator = _get_service(compose, "validator")
        assert validator.get("read_only") is True, "validator must have read_only: true"

    def test_agent_cap_drop_all(self) -> None:
        compose = _load_compose()
        agent = _get_service(compose, "agent")
        cap_drop = agent.get("cap_drop")
        assert cap_drop == ["ALL"], f"agent cap_drop must be [ALL], got {cap_drop}"

    def test_validator_cap_drop_all(self) -> None:
        compose = _load_compose()
        validator = _get_service(compose, "validator")
        cap_drop = validator.get("cap_drop")
        assert cap_drop == ["ALL"], f"validator cap_drop must be [ALL], got {cap_drop}"

    def test_agent_no_new_privileges(self) -> None:
        compose = _load_compose()
        agent = _get_service(compose, "agent")
        sec = agent.get("security_opt", [])
        assert "no-new-privileges:true" in sec, f"agent security_opt must include no-new-privileges:true, got {sec}"

        compose = _load_compose()
        validator = _get_service(compose, "validator")
        sec = validator.get("security_opt", [])
        assert "no-new-privileges:true" in sec, f"validator security_opt must include no-new-privileges:true, got {sec}"

    def test_agent_not_on_validator_network(self) -> None:
        """Agent must not be on validator_net."""
        compose = _load_compose()
        agent = _get_service(compose, "agent")
        nets = agent.get("networks", [])
        # Could be a list of names or dict keys
        if isinstance(nets, list):
            assert "validator_net" not in nets, "agent must not be on validator_net"
        elif isinstance(nets, dict):
            assert "validator_net" not in nets, "agent must not be on validator_net"

    def test_validator_not_on_agent_network(self) -> None:
        """Validator must not be on agent_net."""
        compose = _load_compose()
        validator = _get_service(compose, "validator")
        nets = validator.get("networks", [])
        if isinstance(nets, list):
            assert "agent_net" not in nets, "validator must not be on agent_net"
        elif isinstance(nets, dict):
            assert "agent_net" not in nets, "validator must not be on agent_net"

    def test_agent_no_tmpfs_outside_tmp(self) -> None:
        """Agent tmpfs should only be /tmp (no arbitrary writable paths)."""
        compose = _load_compose()
        agent = _get_service(compose, "agent")
        tmpfs = agent.get("tmpfs", [])
        for entry in tmpfs:
            path = entry.split(":")[0] if isinstance(entry, str) else ""
            assert path == "/tmp", f"agent tmpfs should only be /tmp, found: {path}"

    def test_validator_no_tmpfs_outside_tmp(self) -> None:
        """Validator tmpfs should only be /tmp."""
        compose = _load_compose()
        validator = _get_service(compose, "validator")
        tmpfs = validator.get("tmpfs", [])
        for entry in tmpfs:
            path = entry.split(":")[0] if isinstance(entry, str) else ""
            assert path == "/tmp", f"validator tmpfs should only be /tmp, found: {path}"

    def test_gateway_publishes_localhost_only(self) -> None:
        """Gateway ports must bind to 127.0.0.1 only."""

        ports = gateway.get("ports", [])

"""Test infra/compose.yaml for T-04 isolation properties.

Asserts that agent and validator services:
- have no volumes or bind mounts
- have no published ports
- have read_only: true
- are not on each other's network
- have cap_drop: [ALL]
- have security_opt: [no-new-privileges:true]

Also asserts .dockerignore contains .env.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

import pytest

_REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
_COMPOSE_PATH = _REPO_ROOT / "infra" / "compose.yaml"
_DOCKERIGNORE = _REPO_ROOT / ".dockerignore"


def _load_compose():
    """Load compose.yaml.  Use yaml if available; else skip with reason."""
    try:
        import yaml  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
    except ImportError:
        pytest.skip("PyYAML not installed; compose YAML assertions skipped")
    text = _COMPOSE_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    return yaml.safe_load(text)


def _get_service(compose: dict, name: str) -> dict:
    services = compose.get("services", {})
    assert name in services, f"service '{name}' not found in compose"
    return services[name]


def _network_names(service: dict) -> set[str]:
    """Extract network names from a service definition."""
    nets = service.get("networks", [])
    if isinstance(nets, list):
        return set(nets)
    if isinstance(nets, dict):
        return set(nets.keys())
    return set()


class TestComposeIsolation:
    """Verify agent/validator are isolated per T-04 requirements."""

    def test_compose_file_exists(self) -> None:
        assert _COMPOSE_PATH.exists(), "infra/compose.yaml must exist"

    def test_agent_no_volumes(self) -> None:
        compose = _load_compose()
        agent = _get_service(compose, "agent")
        assert "volumes" not in agent, "agent must not have volumes"

    def test_validator_no_volumes(self) -> None:
        compose = _load_compose()
        validator = _get_service(compose, "validator")
        assert "volumes" not in validator, "validator must not have volumes"

    def test_agent_no_published_ports(self) -> None:
        compose = _load_compose()
        agent = _get_service(compose, "agent")
        assert "ports" not in agent, "agent must not publish ports"

    def test_validator_no_published_ports(self) -> None:
        compose = _load_compose()
        validator = _get_service(compose, "validator")
        assert "ports" not in validator, "validator must not publish ports"

    def test_agent_read_only(self) -> None:
        compose = _load_compose()
        agent = _get_service(compose, "agent")
        assert agent.get("read_only") is True, "agent must have read_only: true"

    def test_validator_read_only(self) -> None:
        compose = _load_compose()
        validator = _get_service(compose, "validator")
        assert validator.get("read_only") is True, "validator must have read_only: true"

    def test_agent_cap_drop_all(self) -> None:
        compose = _load_compose()
        agent = _get_service(compose, "agent")
        cap_drop = agent.get("cap_drop")
        assert cap_drop == ["ALL"], f"agent cap_drop must be [ALL], got {cap_drop}"

    def test_validator_cap_drop_all(self) -> None:
        compose = _load_compose()
        validator = _get_service(compose, "validator")
        cap_drop = validator.get("cap_drop")
        assert cap_drop == ["ALL"], f"validator cap_drop must be [ALL], got {cap_drop}"

    def test_agent_no_new_privileges(self) -> None:
        compose = _load_compose()
        agent = _get_service(compose, "agent")
        sec = agent.get("security_opt", [])
        assert "no-new-privileges:true" in sec, (
            f"agent security_opt must include no-new-privileges:true, got {sec}"
        )

    def test_validator_no_new_privileges(self) -> None:
        compose = _load_compose()
        validator = _get_service(compose, "validator")
        sec = validator.get("security_opt", [])
        assert "no-new-privileges:true" in sec, (
            f"validator security_opt must include no-new-privileges:true, got {sec}"
        )

    def test_agent_not_on_validator_network(self) -> None:
        """Agent must not be on validator_net."""
        compose = _load_compose()
        agent = _get_service(compose, "agent")
        nets = _network_names(agent)
        assert "validator_net" not in nets, "agent must not be on validator_net"

    def test_validator_not_on_agent_network(self) -> None:
        """Validator must not be on agent_net."""
        compose = _load_compose()
        validator = _get_service(compose, "validator")
        nets = _network_names(validator)
        assert "agent_net" not in nets, "validator must not be on agent_net"

    def test_agent_tmpfs_only_tmp(self) -> None:
        """Agent tmpfs should only be /tmp (no arbitrary writable paths)."""
        compose = _load_compose()
        agent = _get_service(compose, "agent")
        tmpfs = agent.get("tmpfs", [])
        for entry in tmpfs:
            path = entry.split(":")[0] if isinstance(entry, str) else ""
            assert path == "/tmp", f"agent tmpfs should only be /tmp, found: {path}"

    def test_validator_tmpfs_only_tmp(self) -> None:
        """Validator tmpfs should only be /tmp."""
        compose = _load_compose()
        validator = _get_service(compose, "validator")
        tmpfs = validator.get("tmpfs", [])
        for entry in tmpfs:
            path = entry.split(":")[0] if isinstance(entry, str) else ""
            assert path == "/tmp", f"validator tmpfs should only be /tmp, found: {path}"

    def test_gateway_publishes_localhost_only(self) -> None:
        """Gateway ports must bind to 127.0.0.1 only."""
        compose = _load_compose()
        gateway = _get_service(compose, "gateway")
        ports = gateway.get("ports", [])
        for p in ports:
            assert "127.0.0.1" in str(p), (
                f"gateway port must bind to 127.0.0.1, got: {p}"
            )

    def test_gateway_has_volume(self) -> None:
        """Gateway must have the gateway_data volume."""
        compose = _load_compose()
        gateway = _get_service(compose, "gateway")
        volumes = gateway.get("volumes", [])
        assert any("gateway_data" in str(v) for v in volumes), (
            f"gateway must mount gateway_data, got: {volumes}"
        )

    def test_agent_no_docker_socket(self) -> None:
        """Agent must not mount docker.sock (no volumes at all)."""
        compose = _load_compose()
        agent = _get_service(compose, "agent")
        assert "volumes" not in agent, "agent has no volumes at all"

    def test_validator_no_docker_socket(self) -> None:
        """Validator must not mount docker.sock (no volumes at all)."""
        compose = _load_compose()
        validator = _get_service(compose, "validator")
        assert "volumes" not in validator, "validator has no volumes at all"

    def test_dockerignore_contains_env(self) -> None:
        """.dockerignore must contain .env."""
        text = _DOCKERIGNORE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        lines = [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines()]
        assert ".env" in lines, ".dockerignore must contain .env"

    def test_dockerignore_contains_env_glob(self) -> None:
        """.dockerignore must contain .env.* to catch variants."""
        text = _DOCKERIGNORE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        lines = [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines()]
        assert ".env.*" in lines, ".dockerignore must contain .env.*"

    def test_dockerignore_excludes_data_and_docs(self) -> None:
        """.dockerignore must exclude data/, docs/, references/, __pycache__."""
        text = _DOCKERIGNORE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        lines = {line.strip() for line in text.splitlines()}
        required = {"data/", "docs/", "references/", "**/__pycache__/"}
        missing = required - lines
        assert not missing, f".dockerignore missing entries: {missing}"

# DCTA service images — T-04 runtime isolation
#
# One Dockerfile with a SERVICE build arg producing three images:
#   gateway   (UID 10001) — contains gateway/ ledger/ shared/
#   agent     (UID 10002) — contains agent/ shared/ prompts/
#   validator (UID 10003) — contains validator/ shared/ prompts/
#
# Agent and validator images contain NO gateway/ or ledger/ source.
# Each runs as a distinct non-root user; application code is owned by root.
#
# Build:
#   docker build --build-arg SERVICE=gateway   -t dcta-gateway   -f infra/Dockerfile .
#   docker build --build-arg SERVICE=agent     -t dcta-agent     -f infra/Dockerfile .
#   docker build --build-arg SERVICE=validator -t dcta-validator -f infra/Dockerfile .

ARG SERVICE=gateway

# ── Builder stage: install all dependencies from the lockfile ──────────
# The venv is created at /app/.venv so shebangs match the runtime path.
FROM python:3.12-slim AS builder

# git is required because trtc-asr is a git source in uv.lock
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install uv (pinned to match the project)
COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.9.15 /uv /uvx /bin/

# Create /app so the venv lives at /app/.venv (matching runtime)
RUN mkdir -p /app
WORKDIR /app

# Copy only lockfile + project metadata for dependency resolution
COPY pyproject.toml uv.lock ./

# Sync dependencies from the lockfile (frozen, no dev, no project install)
# Creates /app/.venv with all runtime dependencies including trtc-asr.
# UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT defaults to .venv under WORKDIR → /app/.venv
RUN uv sync --frozen --no-dev --no-install-project

# ── Gateway runtime ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
FROM python:3.12-slim AS gateway

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
ENV PATH="/app/.venv/bin:$PATH"
ENV PYTHONPATH="/app"

RUN groupadd -g 10001 dcta && \
    useradd -u 10001 -g dcta -d /app -s /sbin/nologin dcta && \
    mkdir -p /app /data/audio && \
    chown -R dcta:dcta /data

WORKDIR /app

COPY --from=builder /app/.venv /app/.venv
COPY --chown=root:root --chmod=0555 shared/ /app/shared/
COPY --chown=root:root --chmod=0555 gateway/ /app/gateway/
COPY --chown=root:root --chmod=0555 ledger/ /app/ledger/

RUN touch /app/shared/__init__.py /app/gateway/__init__.py /app/ledger/__init__.py

USER dcta

CMD ["uvicorn", "gateway.app:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8002"]

# ── Agent runtime ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FROM python:3.12-slim AS agent

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
ENV PATH="/app/.venv/bin:$PATH"
ENV PYTHONPATH="/app"

RUN groupadd -g 10002 dcta && \
    useradd -u 10002 -g dcta -d /app -s /sbin/nologin dcta

WORKDIR /app

COPY --from=builder /app/.venv /app/.venv
COPY --chown=root:root --chmod=0555 shared/ /app/shared/
COPY --chown=root:root --chmod=0555 agent/ /app/agent/
COPY --chown=root:root --chmod=0555 prompts/ /app/prompts/

RUN touch /app/shared/__init__.py /app/agent/__init__.py

USER dcta

CMD ["uvicorn", "agent.app:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8001"]

# ── Validator runtime ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
FROM python:3.12-slim AS validator

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
ENV PATH="/app/.venv/bin:$PATH"
ENV PYTHONPATH="/app"

RUN groupadd -g 10003 dcta && \
    useradd -u 10003 -g dcta -d /app -s /sbin/nologin dcta

WORKDIR /app

COPY --from=builder /app/.venv /app/.venv
COPY --chown=root:root --chmod=0555 shared/ /app/shared/
COPY --chown=root:root --chmod=0555 validator/ /app/validator/
COPY --chown=root:root --chmod=0555 prompts/ /app/prompts/

RUN touch /app/shared/__init__.py /app/validator/__init__.py

USER dcta

CMD ["uvicorn", "validator.app:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8003"]

The agent probe shows 1 FAIL on "own /health". The issue is that the `timeout` command isn't available on macOS, so the health-wait loop failed and the containers weren't fully healthy when the agent probe ran. Let me check — the validator passed because by the time it ran, the services were healthy. The agent probe ran too early.

The issue is `timeout: command not found` on macOS. Let me fix the Makefile to not use `timeout` (which is a GNU coreutils command not available on macOS by default). I'll use a different approach.

66→	@$(COMPOSE) build 2>&1 | tail -5
  67→	@echo "Starting stack…" >&2
  68→	@$(COMPOSE) up -d 2>&1 | tail -5
  69→	@echo "Waiting for health (up to 60s)…" >&2
  70→	@timeout 60 bash -c 'i=0; while [ $$i -lt 30 ]; do \
  71→		status=$$($(COMPOSE) ps --format json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; data=json.load(sys.stdin); healthy=all(s.get(\"Health\",\"\")==\"healthy\" for s in data if s.get(\"Health\")); exit(0 if healthy and len(data)>=3 else 1)" 2>/dev/null && echo ok || echo wait); \
  72→		if [ "$$status" = "ok" ]; then break; fi; \
  73→		echo "  waiting… ($$i)"; sleep 2; i=$$((i+1)); \
  74→	done' || true
